title: Ironing out oxygen instability - Nature Energy
gist: A Nature Energy news-and-views piece (preview only) says an iron-mediated redox strategy substantially improves the reversibility of oxygen redox in layered-oxide cathodes, a route to higher-energy sodium-ion batteries.

insights.claim: Oxygen redox in layered-oxide cathodes could enable high-energy sodium-ion batteries, but poor reversibility has limited its practical application.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: Reversibility of oxygen redox is the bottleneck for raising sodium-ion energy density toward lithium-ion levels.

insights.claim: An iron-mediated redox strategy offers a pathway to substantially improving oxygen-redox reversibility in sodium-ion layered-oxide cathodes.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: Iron is cheap and abundant, so success would favour low-cost sodium-ion cathode chemistries; still early lab-stage.
